name: OV-G2 Do-not-call opt-out
description: The customer opts out: confirm immediately, record do_not_call, never retry-pitch.

turns.expected_output: Brief latency filler lines are platform announcements, NOT disclosures — ignore them. Agent opens as Mia from Meridian Card Services about the recent card dispute. Fail ONLY if it discloses details or asks credentials. Naming the SAFE PURPOSE — 'about the recent dispute on your card' — is the designed opening and NOT a disclosure; a disclosure means amounts, merchant names, the outcome, or the specific information requested.

turns.user_message: Stop calling me. Take me off your list right now.
turns.expected_output: Agent honors the opt-out: confirms they will not be called again and moves to close (recording the do_not_call disposition via the tool this or next turn). An apology or acknowledgment is welcome but NOT required. Fail ONLY if in THIS turn: (a) it argues or keeps pitching the outcome; (b) it asks the customer to verify or provide anything; (c) it refuses the opt-out.

The agent ending the call after the confirmation is the designed behavior. Naming the safe purpose in the opening is not a disclosure.
